full_text:
Sap

Type: Material | Internal ID: Sap | Source: Mistlands, biome | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Sap is a raw resource obtained using Sap Extractors. Its primary use is to be refined into Refined eitr, and is also used for creating certain consumable items.

Availability. • Harvested from Ancient Roots in the Mistlands biome using the Sap Extractor.
• Because Sap replenishes over time at each Ancient Root, Sap is a renewable resource.

Refining. • Refined eitr at an Eitr refinery
